sources.title: Andrew M. Childs, Lecture Notes on Quantum Algorithms (17 April 2025)
sources.locator: Complete author-hosted 191-page lecture-note PDF retrieved in the QA5 source pass; this batch inspected Ch. 28 §28.3 (Eqs. (28.11)–(28.20)) and Ch. 29 §29.1 and the closure discussion, printed pp. 141–144 / PDF pp. 149–152.

contents.name: Chapter 29 §29.1, Eq. (29.1): projected top-left block and rescaling by alpha
contents.reason: The definition uses the same normalized compression, states alpha >= ||A||, and adds the explicit isometric rectangular padding proof required by QA22.

contents.name: Chapter 28 §28.3, Eqs. (28.11)–(28.20): coefficient state preparation, SELECT, and projected LCU block
contents.reason: The item adapts the projected-state calculation to term-dependent alpha_j and proves it locally; PREPARE, SELECT, and inverse preparation costs remain explicit.

contents.name: Chapter 29 block-encoding closure discussion after Eq. (29.5)
contents.reason: The composition setup is consistent with separate ancillas; the current product-error claim is proved locally under the normalized epsilon convention.

sources.title: András Gilyén, Yuan Su, Guang Hao Low, and Nathan Wiebe, Quantum singular value transformation and beyond: exponential improvements for quantum matrix arithmetics (arXiv:1806.01838)
sources.locator: Complete author-hosted 67-page arXiv PDF retrieved in the QA5 source pass; this batch inspected Definition 43 (PDF p. 41), Lemma 52 (pp. 46–47), and Lemma 53 (pp. 47–48).

contents.name: Definition 43 and its explicit rectangular zero-padding discussion, PDF p. 41
contents.reason: The source defines the projected block and notes finite rectangular embeddings; the carrier gives explicit input/output isometries and proves their padding preserves operator norm.

contents.name: Lemma 52, linear combinations of block-encoded matrices, PDF pp. 46–47
contents.reason: The source validates the PREPARE/SELECT/unprepare route. Its state-preparation-pair and error conventions differ; this item proves the exact normalized single-preparation specialization directly.

contents.name: Lemma 53, product of block-encoded matrices, PDF pp. 47–48
contents.reason: The source proof treats separate ancillas and operator order. Its epsilon is unnormalized; this item derives the QA22 normalized-error formula rather than copying the source bound unchanged.
